manual_or_upload.label: Google Takeout "YouTube and YouTube Music" export
manual_or_upload.description: Request a Google Takeout export of "YouTube and YouTube Music", wait for the download link, then extract it and provide the folder here.

acquisition_methods.label: Request your export from Google Takeout
acquisition_methods.detail: Go to takeout.google.com, deselect all, select only "YouTube and YouTube Music", and create the export. Google emails a download link, usually within a few hours. Download the .zip, extract it, and place the extracted folder (or its contents) where this connector reads from.

manual_or_upload.help_text: This is the optional Takeout profile retained alongside the browser-first youtube profile. It requires an owner-requested export and is excluded from publication pending review.
manual_or_upload.large_file_fallback: This connector reads an already-extracted export directory, not the .zip directly. Extract the Takeout archive yourself and point YOUTUBE_TAKEOUT_DIR at the extracted folder.
validation_expectations: Detected a Google Takeout "YouTube and YouTube Music" export directory
Reported per-stream coverage: which expected files were found, which were not
Estimated record counts per stream that was found

refresh_policy.rationale: Collection reads a Takeout export the owner requested; there is no credential, no session and nothing to poll, so an unattended run has nothing to collect. Refreshing means the owner requesting a new Takeout export and providing it again, which Google can take hours to days to prepare.

streams.name: profile
streams.description: The owner's YouTube channel identity, from the Takeout channel export. UNVERIFIED: no confirmed real export has proven this file's path or columns (see coverage_diagnostics).

display.label: Your YouTube channel
display.detail: Channel id and URL from the Takeout channel export. Title, handle, join date, and stats are not present in that file and stay null.

streams.name: subscriptions
streams.description: Channels the owner is subscribed to, from the Takeout subscriptions export. UNVERIFIED path/columns — see coverage_diagnostics.

display.label: Your subscriptions
display.detail: Channel id, URL, and title. Handle, avatar, subscriber count, verification, and notification state are not present in the export file this connector reads and stay null.

streams.name: playlists
streams.description: Playlists the owner created, from the Takeout playlists index. UNVERIFIED path/columns — see coverage_diagnostics.

display.label: Your playlists
display.detail: Playlist id and name. URL, owner, visibility, video count, and view count are not present in the index file this connector reads and stay null.

streams.name: playlist_items
streams.description: Videos inside the owner's playlists, one record per (playlist, video). UNVERIFIED path/columns — see coverage_diagnostics.

display.label: Your playlist items
display.detail: Video id and a derived watch URL per playlist entry. Title, channel, duration, and thumbnail are not present in the per-playlist export file this connector reads and stay null.

streams.name: likes
streams.description: Videos the owner liked, from the Takeout "Liked videos" playlist export. UNVERIFIED path/columns — see coverage_diagnostics.

display.label: Your liked videos
display.detail: Video id and a derived watch URL. Title, channel, duration, and thumbnail are not present in the export file this connector reads and stay null.

streams.name: watch_later
streams.description: Videos saved to Watch Later, from the Takeout "Watch later" playlist export. UNVERIFIED path/columns — see coverage_diagnostics.

display.label: Your watch later list
display.detail: Video id and a derived watch URL. Title, channel, duration, and thumbnail are not present in the export file this connector reads and stay null.

streams.name: watch_history
streams.description: Videos the owner watched, from the Takeout watch-history.json export. VERIFIED: same file format and parser as google_takeout.youtube_watch_history (src/youtube-watch-history.ts).

display.label: Your watch history
display.detail: Watched timestamp, video id, video URL, title, and channel. View count and description are not present in the Takeout history export and stay null.

streams.name: coverage_diagnostics
streams.description: What this import covered per stream and why it stops where it does. One record per stream per import.

display.label: What your YouTube import covered
display.detail: Whether each expected Takeout file was found, how many records it produced, and which fields are not available from this export.

reason_display_messages.awaiting_upload: Nothing to read yet. Request a Takeout export of "YouTube and YouTube Music", extract it, and provide the folder here.
reason_display_messages.covered_in_full: Everything this export carries for this stream was imported.
reason_display_messages.nothing_in_range: Your export didn't contain any records for this stream. That's not a problem — there was simply nothing to read.
reason_display_messages.records_unreadable: Some entries in your export couldn't be read and were skipped — everything else imported normally.
reason_display_messages.source_unreadable: The import folder contains a .zip, not an extracted export. Extract it and point the import directory at the extracted contents.
reason_display_messages.file_not_found_in_export: This stream's expected file was not found in your Takeout export. Coverage for this stream is unverified — Google's Takeout export contents can vary; report this if you expected data here.
